rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a judge presiding over court cases.

example.english: The judge sentenced him to prison.
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 pun3 keoi5 jap6 juk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for assessing something or inferring a conclusion from evidence.

example.english: After reading the report, I could judge whether the matter was real or fake.
example.traditional: 睇完份報告，我先判斷到件事係真定假。
example.jyutping: tai2 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 sin1 pun3 dyun6 dou2 gin6 si6 hai6 zan1 ding6 gaa2

rows.note: Use this for the official who enforces the rules during a sports match or contest.

example.english: The judge blew the whistle, and the match was over.
example.jyutping: coi4 pun3 ceoi1 zo2 gai1 coeng4 bo1 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a judge who assesses contestants or entries rather than officiating the action itself.

example.jyutping: ping4 pun3 gaan2 zo2 gun3 gwan1

rows.note: Use this everyday verb when a court or authority imposes a sentence on someone.

example.english: The judge sentenced him to three years in prison.
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 pun3 keoi5 zo6 saam1 nin4 gaam1

rows.note: Use this formal verb for conducting a judicial trial or acting in judgment over a case.

example.english: The court will judge this case next week.
example.traditional: 法庭將於下星期審判呢宗案件。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 sing1 kei4 sam2 pun3 ni1 zung1 on3 gin6

rows.note: Use this when deciding who is right or settling an argument between people.

example.english: Stop arguing and let me judge who is right.
example.traditional: 你哋唔好嘈，等我嚟評理。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 cou4 dang2 ngo5 lai4 ping4 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a public critic or commentator who evaluates things and gives opinions.

example.english: The judge said the movie was boring.
example.jyutping: ping4 leon6 gaa1 waa6 tou3 hei3 hou2 mun6
